Job Description:

What It Means To Be a Consultant At Crowe

Consulting is a dynamic business focused on solving problems for our clients and serving our core markets through innovative solutions. As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. At Crowe, consultants are expected to build both technical and transferable skills, think critically, and use technology to solve real business problems. In this role, you will continuously learn, collaborate across teams, and explore how tools, including emerging AI capabilities, can improve efficiency, insights, and client outcomes.

As you grow, you’ll also begin to take ownership of client relationships, contribute to account strategy, and support the delivery of high-impact work. Developing a sense of account leadership, including understanding client needs, ensuring delivery excellence, and building trusted partnerships, is part of what sets successful consultants apart.

Success in this role comes from a growth mindset, strong communication skills, advanced critical thinking, and the ability to navigate new challenges with confidence.

The Salesforce Project Coordinator will help teams plan and execute the vision for our clients through transformative technologies to solve real-world business problems with sound business principles. This position will lead teams in a collaborative environment, overseeing the creation of the Salesforce experience utilizing our robust process and services. The Senior Project Manager will manage the end-to-end execution of projects with internal creative and development teams to deliver tangible value.

Key Responsibilities Include

Plan, lead and control complex Salesforce projects and related personnel utilizing project methodologies and related tools to bring projects to successful completion, within scope, on time, and within budget
Manage day-to-day operational aspects of projects; adapting as necessary while working with key internal and external stakeholders to establish and gain consensus on project goals, objectives, and deliverables
Maintain prompt, proactive, and transparent communication with the client to provide strategic and tactical thought partnership to effectively drive project delivery
Lead team and client meetings, ensuring timely follow-up and holding project team members accountable
Provide daily task coordination, action tracking and project evaluation
Leverage data to measure and monitor progress against commitments and provide transparency to project team
Coach clients on Agile practices and champion the right Agile frameworks based on the type of work
Use effective decision making to control risk and minimize uncertainty while being proactive through strategic thinking to strive to find new and innovative ways to deliver successful results
Implement streamlined, effective processes through change management
Mentor and train entry level team members; play a key role in the interviewing and onboarding process for new Project Managers
Operate as an innovative thought leader; contribute significantly to the overall growth and quality of the department through knowledge sharing and coaching on current best practices and market trends

Basic Qualifications:

Minimum of 2 years of experience in technology-focused project management
Minimum of 1-2 years of experience working with Agile teams on technology projects
Experience managing and forecasting budgets
Ability to provide attention to detail and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment
Experience creating and maintaining a project plan from inception through completion
Demonstrated success in leading multiple enterprise strategic projects from end-to-end
Excellent verbal and written communication skills with experience presenting to C-Level management
Excellent organizational, multi-tasking, facilitation, and time management skills
Excellent interpersonal skills; able to maintain solid rapport through the various working styles of team members as well as clients
Ability to collaborate and apply critical thinking and problem-solving skills as required
We appreciate talent from all over the United States and are willing to consider candidates who may not be located near a Crowe office location for this role/opening.
Bachelor’s degree

Certification in Agile, Project Management, or Business Process Management, highly preferred (or willingness to achieve identified certification within first 12 months of employment)
Experience working with Salesforce, highly preferred

Process and analyze geospatial and tabular datasets

Background in geospatial analysis, data science, or related field
Experience with Python (preferred) and GIS tools (QGIS / ArcGIS)
Ability to work with structured and unstructured datasets
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Interest in applied work (mining, energy, development, or risk analysis)

Opportunity to work on real-world analytical applications

jobs.title: Lead Safety & Environmental Analyst
jobs.description:
About Peraton

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world's leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees solve the most daunting challenges that our customers face. Visit peraton.com to learn how we're keeping people around the world safe and secure.

Program Overview

Provide critical communications and tracking for multiple spacecraft from three complexes located globally, and operates year round 24 hours/7days to provide continuous contact with the spacecraft. The program fulfills NASA goals by supporting NASA deep space mission set, including NASA-funded missions and collaborative international missions.

About The Role

We are looking for a Lead Safety & Environmental Analyst
to support our Deep Space Network (DSN) Operations and Maintenance O&M contract with the Jet Propulsion Laboratory (JPL) and NASA in Fort Irwin, CA.

What You'll Do:

As Lead Safety & Environmental Analyst, your primary responsibility is ensuring the safety of personnel working in and around complex antenna, mechanical, and electrical systems at a remote government facility. You will lead safety programs, investigate incidents, drive risk reduction, and maintain regulatory compliance across the full spectrum of EHS disciplines - with a clear emphasis on occupational safety first.

Core Safety Responsibilities:

Lead and continuously improve site safety programs, with emphasis on high-hazard work (electrical, elevated, confined space, heavy equipment)
Conduct and lead incident investigations; identify root causes and drive corrective actions to closure
Conduct hazard assessments, job safety analysis (JSAs), and Management of Change (MOC) reviews
Perform and lead EHS audits, field observations, and self-assessments; report findings to leadership
Lead or support emergency response planning and exercises
Analyze safety performance data (OSHA 300 logs, LTIR, frequency rates) and present trends to stakeholders

Training & Compliance:

Develop and deliver EHS training programs; certify trainers where applicable (OSHA 500/501)
Ensure compliance with federal and California regulations (OSHA, Cal/OSHA, EPA, Cal/EPA, NFPA, APCD)
Manage Air Quality and Water programs, including regulatory reporting and agency coordination
Prepare internal and external compliance reports, including data analysis and trend summaries

Collaboration & Communication:

Serve as the primary EHS point of contact for site management, trade personnel, and JPL/NASA stakeholders
Represent the program in discussions with regulatory agencies and community stakeholders
Provide guidance and mentorship to junior EHS staff

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

BS/BA + 8 years of experience; MS/MA + 6 years; PhD + 3 years; or 4 years of directly relevant experience in lieu of degree
Strong knowledge of OSHA, Cal/OSHA, EPA, NIOSH, NFPA, and APCD regulations; NASA familiarity is a plus
Demonstrated experience leading safety programs in complex industrial or government facility environments
Experience with construction safety oversight and managing shifting project priorities
Ability to analyze EHS data and communicate findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
Valid California driver's license (Read-ID)
U.S. citizenship required; must pass background check and NCIC screening

Preferred Qualifications:

Certified Safety Professional (CSP) or OHST/CHST (BCSP)
OSHA 500/501 Train-the-Trainer certification
Prior experience in government or DOD facility contracts

Details

Target Salary Range: $80,000 - $128,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual's experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.

Benefits Statement: Peraton offers eligible employees a variety of benefits including medical, dental, vision, life, health savings account, short/long term disability, EAP, parental leave, 401(k), paid time off (PTO) for vacation, and company paid holidays. A full listing of available benefits can be viewed at https://www.careers.peraton.com/benefits.

Application Statements: The application period for the job is estimated to be 30 days from the job posting date. However, this timeline may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates. By applying to this job, you are expressing interest in the role and the Company. During the review of your application, you may be required to participate in an on-camera interview, as well as participate in a process to verify your identity. Use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools of any kind during Peraton interviews is strictly prohibited unless the candidate has obtained prior written authorization. All interview responses must be the candidate's own.

Title:
Project Coordinator

Industry
: Transportation

Location
: Arvada, CO

Work Schedule
: Monday–Friday, 7:00 AM–3:30 PM | 100% Onsite

Benefits
: This position is eligible for medical, dental, vision, and 401(k).

About The Company:

Our client is an established organization specializing in transportation technology, infrastructure, and construction-related services. The company combines the resources of a large organization with a collaborative, close-knit team environment. With continued growth and evolving business operations, employees have opportunities to expand their skills, contribute new ideas, and advance professionally.

Job Description:

We are seeking a detail-oriented Project Coordinator to provide administrative, financial, and operational support to a busy project management team. This individual will work closely with Project Managers to coordinate construction documentation, maintain accurate project records, oversee billing activities, and ensure contractual requirements are completed throughout the project lifecycle.

The ideal candidate has a strong background in construction project coordination, experience with ERP accounting systems, and a solid understanding of construction billing and contract administration. This position requires someone who can manage competing priorities, communicate effectively with multiple stakeholders, and adapt to changing processes and technology.

Key Responsibilities:

Coordinate daily communication among Project Managers, field personnel, contractors, subcontractors, vendors, and internal operations teams.
Establish and update project records within an ERP platform, including purchase orders, subcontract agreements, change orders, and financial documentation.
Organize and maintain electronic project folders, ensuring contracts, correspondence, and supporting documents are accurate and accessible.
Prepare and process customer invoices using various billing structures, including milestone-based, percentage-of-completion, AIA, unit pricing, and time-and-materials methods.
Monitor contractual compliance requirements, including certified payroll, lien releases, DBE reporting, and other project-specific documentation.
Track construction-related paperwork such as RFIs, submittals, purchase orders, contract modifications, and progress reports.
Partner with vendors and subcontractors to coordinate purchasing activities, billing submissions, and contract updates.
Review project financial information and assist with maintaining accurate billing and accounting records.
Respond to customer and vendor inquiries while ensuring timely resolution of outstanding items.
Assist Project Managers and field teams with purchasing requests, documentation needs, and general project coordination.
Identify opportunities to streamline administrative processes and support the adoption of new systems and procedures.
Provide additional administrative and operational assistance to the project management team as needed.

Qualifications:

3–5+ years of experience in project coordination, project administration, or a related construction support role.
Previous experience in construction, engineering consulting, architecture, or a similar project-based industry.
Strong understanding of construction contracts, project invoicing, billing procedures, and document management.
Experience working with purchase orders, subcontract agreements, RFIs, submittals, and change orders.
Intermediate to advanced Microsoft Excel skills and proficiency with Microsoft Outlook.
Hands-on experience with ERP or project accounting software; familiarity with Viewpoint Spectrum is highly preferred.
Ability to interpret contractual requirements and maintain accurate project documentation.
Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects, deadlines, and competing priorities.
Strong written and verbal communication skills with a professional, service-oriented approach.
High level of accuracy and attention to detail when reviewing financial and contractual information.
Comfortable learning new software, adjusting to evolving procedures, and contributing ideas for process improvements.
Experience supporting purchasing, accounts payable, accounts receivable, or payroll functions is a plus.

Additional Details:

The position requires working onsite five days per week.
The role supports a small project management team and involves regular interaction with internal and external stakeholders.
Candidates should be comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where priorities and project requirements may change.

Perks:

Opportunity to join an established and growing organization.
Collaborative team environment with direct exposure to Project Managers.
Hands-on experience with construction operations, project accounting, and contract administration.
Opportunity to expand technical skills and contribute to process improvements.
Professional development and long-term growth potential.

We are seeking a detail-oriented Project Coordinator to provide administrative, financial, and operational support to a busy project management team. This individual will work closely with Project Managers to coordinate construction documentation, maintain accurate project records, oversee billing activities, and ensure contractual requirements are completed throughout the project lifecycle.

The ideal candidate has a strong background in construction project coordination, experience with ERP accounting systems, and a solid understanding of construction billing and contract administration. This position requires someone who can manage competing priorities, communicate effectively with multiple stakeholders, and adapt to changing processes and technology.

Key Responsibilities:

Coordinate daily communication among Project Managers, field personnel, contractors, subcontractors, vendors, and internal operations teams.
Establish and update project records within an ERP platform, including purchase orders, subcontract agreements, change orders, and financial documentation.
Organize and maintain electronic project folders, ensuring contracts, correspondence, and supporting documents are accurate and accessible.
Prepare and process customer invoices using various billing structures, including milestone-based, percentage-of-completion, AIA, unit pricing, and time-and-materials methods.
Monitor contractual compliance requirements, including certified payroll, lien releases, DBE reporting, and other project-specific documentation.
Track construction-related paperwork such as RFIs, submittals, purchase orders, contract modifications, and progress reports.
Partner with vendors and subcontractors to coordinate purchasing activities, billing submissions, and contract updates.
Review project financial information and assist with maintaining accurate billing and accounting records.
Respond to customer and vendor inquiries while ensuring timely resolution of outstanding items.
Assist Project Managers and field teams with purchasing requests, documentation needs, and general project coordination.
Identify opportunities to streamline administrative processes and support the adoption of new systems and procedures.
Provide additional administrative and operational assistance to the project management team as needed.

Qualifications:

3–5+ years of experience in project coordination, project administration, or a related construction support role.
Previous experience in construction, engineering consulting, architecture, or a similar project-based industry.
Strong understanding of construction contracts, project invoicing, billing procedures, and document management.
Experience working with purchase orders, subcontract agreements, RFIs, submittals, and change orders.
Intermediate to advanced Microsoft Excel skills and proficiency with Microsoft Outlook.
Hands-on experience with ERP or project accounting software; familiarity with Viewpoint Spectrum is highly preferred.
Ability to interpret contractual requirements and maintain accurate project documentation.
Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects, deadlines, and competing priorities.
Strong written and verbal communication skills with a professional, service-oriented approach.
High level of accuracy and attention to detail when reviewing financial and contractual information.
Comfortable learning new software, adjusting to evolving procedures, and contributing ideas for process improvements.
Experience supporting purchasing, accounts payable, accounts receivable, or payroll functions is a plus.

Additional Details:

The position requires working onsite five days per week.
The role supports a small project management team and involves regular interaction with internal and external stakeholders.
Candidates should be comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where priorities and project requirements may change.

Perks:

Opportunity to join an established and growing organization.
Collaborative team environment with direct exposure to Project Managers.
Hands-on experience with construction operations, project accounting, and contract administration.
Opportunity to expand technical skills and contribute to process improvements.
Professional development and long-term growth potential.

As a Senior Business Data Analyst, you will serve as a senior analytics partner and business intelligence subject matter expert, helping offices across the institution transform complex data into meaningful, actionable insights by conducting analysis, visualizing data, providing context, and helping stakeholders understand trends, performance, risks, and opportunities. In this role, you will work closely with leadership and staff to define business questions, clarify analytical needs, develop trusted data assets, and create dashboards and reporting that support strategic decision-making. You will play a key role in expanding analytics support beyond the Office of the Chief Financial Officer to institutional partners such as the Office of Strategy and Engagement, the Office of Peer Review, and the National Research Council Executive Office.

Job Description

ESSENTIAL JOB DUTIES

Duties may be performed solely for a specific business or functional area or a combination of areas.

Institutional Analytics and Stakeholder Partnership
: Partners with leadership and staff across institutional units to understand business needs, define analytical questions, clarify reporting goals, identify relevant metrics, assess available data, and determine the most effective analytical approach. Conducts analysis to identify trends, patterns, risks, opportunities, and key findings, and translates those findings into clear insights that support planning, operational improvement, performance tracking, and senior leadership decision-making.

Dashboard Development and Business Intelligence
: Designs, builds, tests, publishes, and maintains dashboards and reporting products in Tableau and related business intelligence platforms. Creates dashboards that are accurate, accessible, visually clear, and aligned with stakeholder needs. Manages the release of assigned dashboards, including requirements gathering, stakeholder review, testing, documentation, publication, and post-release support.

Analytics Infrastructure:
Develops and maintains a unified analytics foundation for Tableau by creating consistent structures, reusable data assets, transformation logic, and common business rules that allow data from multiple sources to be used reliably across Business Data Analytics products. Ensures that analytical workflows are sustainable, scalable, well-documented, structured in a way that supports consistent analysis, reduces duplication, and strengthens confidence in reported results and designed to support both current reporting needs and future growth.

Data Assets:
Designs, builds, and maintains data assets in the Tableau data ecosystem for senior leadership decision support by ensuring the overall accuracy, completeness, and reliability of datasets and data models.

Data Quality
: Supports strong data quality practices within Business Data Analytics by helping ensure that key metrics, definitions, assumptions, and business rules are applied consistently across analytics products. Identifies and communicates data quality issues, source system limitations, and interpretation considerations that may affect reporting or decision-making. Contributes to clear, transparent use of data with documentation.

Consultation:
Provides expert guidance to stakeholders on data interpretation, reporting approaches and analytical best practices. Supports technical components of dashboard development such as consulting on coding buildout.

Staff Management:
May train and coach analytical staff. If supervising staff, provides leadership and mentors employees. Trains and develops employees to successfully perform current responsibilities and encourages development of staff for future roles. Forms effective teams and cultivates a work environment that fosters teamwork. Interprets and ensures consistent application of organizational policies. Initiates personnel actions, including performance and compensation reviews and disciplinary actions. Mentors, collaborates with, and advises data analytics team members.

Confidentiality:
Maintains an appropriate standard of confidentiality. Maintains strict confidence and exercises care when handling secure, privileged, sensitive, or confidential information and matters to prevent disclosure to others. Accesses confidential information for work-related reasons only, following the policies and procedures of the organization. Ensures that any privileged, sensitive, or confidential information is securely stored, disposed of, and transmitted according to the Institutional guidance.

Nonessential Job Duties

Related duties and special projects as assigned.

JOB SPECIFICATIONS

Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:
Thorough knowledge of up-to-date data analysis techniques. Deep understanding of utilization of data analysis and visualization tools, platforms, and software (i.e., Tableau). Above average to advance level computer skills which may include SQL, Excel and Google Analytics. Abilities to manage data pipelines for highly complex data. Strong organizational, problem-solving, and presentation skills. Excellent attention to detail. Ability to meet deadlines in a fast-paced office environment during peak periods. Ability to manage and maintain privileged, sensitive, and confidential information and matters appropriately. Ability to solve non-routine intellectual problems of substantial variety and complexity using originality and ingenuity. Serves as a resource to others in the resolution of complex problems. Ability to use substantial latitude for independent judgment and action. Experience working in complex environments with a high degree of organizational effectiveness. Ability to successfully work in a team environment and to form and maintain effective teams. Ability to develop relationships with co-workers and employees in other National Academies’ departments through effective communication. Excellent communication skills with a proven ability to effectively interact with all levels of employees.

Minimum Education/Training Requirements:
Bachelor’s Degree in relevant field or related field, or equivalent knowledge. Master’s Degree is preferred.

Minimum Experience:
Six years of related professional experience. Tableau, data analysis, and visualizations is required. Advanced experience in Tableau Desktop and Tableau Prep is required. Experience with Snowflake preferred.

Physical Capabilities:
Ability to work at a computer for extended periods of time.

Required Licenses, Certification or Registration:
None.

Supervisory Responsibilities/Controls:
Reports to Director of Business Data Analytics. General direction is provided. May supervise staff.

Work Environment:
Office environment with occasional travel between National Academies’ facilities and to off-site locations. Additional hours may be required to support internal and external deadlines during peak periods. 60% telework eligible.

Lead Data Analyst (Hybrid)

Chicago, IL

The American Medical Association (AMA) is the nation's largest professional Association of physicians and a non-profit organization. We are a unifying voice and powerful ally for America's physicians, the patients they care for, and the promise of a healthier nation. To be part of the AMA is to be part of our Mission to promote the art and science of medicine and the betterment of public health.

At AMA, our mission to improve the health of the nation starts with our people. We foster an inclusive, people-first culture where every employee is empowered to perform at their best. Together, we advance meaningful change in health care and the communities we serve.

We encourage and support professional development for our employees, and we are dedicated to social responsibility. We invite you to learn more about us and we look forward to getting to know you.

We have an opportunity at our corporate offices in Chicago for a Lead Data Analyst (Hybrid)
on our Health Policy team. This is a hybrid position reporting into our Chicago, IL office, requiring 3 days a week in the office.

As a Lead Data Analyst, you will be responsible for the development and maintenance of critical data resources to enhance the overall effectiveness AMA/Specialty Society RVS Update Committee (RUC) process and the submission of recommendations to the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS). Lead claims and other data analysis to ensure accuracy in the Medicare payment system and to support other AMA advocacy goals.

Data Analysis

Perform data complex data analysis of Medicare, Medicare Advantage and Medicaid claims data for utilization in the CPT Editorial Panel and RUC processes.
Utilize claims data and other data sources tosupport AMA Advocacy staff in addressing proposed regulation and legislation.
Provide data analysis to the RUC and RUC Subcommittees to inform methodology considerations.
Perform utilization projections and budget neutrality assumption via liaison with specialty societies for submission to CMS.
Collaborate with Advocacy staff in physician payment advocacy and discussion with CMS, MedPAC legislative staff and other organizations by providing data analysis, as requested.
Write, edit, and oversee the development of reports and educational material related to claims analysis.

RBRVS Data Mangement

Prepare and manage data reports for CMS for submission with RUC recommendations related to resource costs.
Manage the integrity of the RUC data retention process. Manage an extensive and complex database tool of RUC and RBRVS information for individual physician services.

Effectively advocate for physicians' interests by analyzing claims data, Medicare payments and other data to develop persuasive arguments for presentation to CMS, MedPAC, and other organizations
Prepare data files for to be utilized in AMA products, including clinical vignettes and CPT/RVU products.

Expert knowledge and experience with Stata, SAS, and SQL.
Excellent interpersonal skills, including the ability to communicate and deliver effective presentations and successfully interact with physicians and policymakers.
Strong research and analytical skills, including the ability to independently and efficiently locate information, evaluate and concisely present findings.
Strong project management skills, including the ability to independently initiate, manage, and execute multiple policy projects in a fast-paced team environment under tight deadlines.
Demonstrated ability to work in a team focused environment.
Organizational sensitivity and a sense of confidentiality and discretion required.
Knowledge of medical terminology and coding preferred.
Demonstrated experience with Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel and Access required.
Some travel required, including overnight and weekend meetings.

Description

POSITION: COMMERCIAL DATA ANALYST

Who We Are

OptiMed Health Partners optimizes health outcomes and quality of life through personalized and coordinated care. We have been serving patients for over 30 years with a focus on high-quality care in retail pharmacy, specialty pharmacy, and infusion services. The OptiMed Vision reimagines healthcare solutions to achieve unsurpassed value. Our results-oriented culture fosters learning, providing growth opportunities for our employees and exceptional care for our patients in all 50 states.

The Impact Of This Role

The Commercial Data Analyst provides analytical and technical expertise to collect, interpret, validate, and analyze claims, utilization, pricing, financial, and operational data in support of OptiMed's commercial activities.

The Commercial Data Analyst will work closely with Sales and partner with clinical, pharmacy, operational, and financial subject matter experts to evaluate opportunities and translate business knowledge into accurate, repeatable analysis. The position will utilize available technology and analytical tools to organize, cleanse, transform, reconcile, and analyze data while maintaining a high level of accuracy and integrity.

The Commercial Data Analyst will also assist the organization in advancing and improving its analytical capabilities by developing standardized methodologies, documenting business rules, improving the use of existing technology, and identifying opportunities to reduce repetitive manual analysis. Over time, the position will help create a stronger connection between what OptiMed expects when an opportunity is evaluated, what is ultimately implemented and delivered, and the financial and operational results achieved.

The Commercial Data Analyst currently reports to the Technology Account Manager and works closely with Sales, Finance, Pharmacy, Operations, Revenue Cycle, and Technology stakeholders.

What You’ll Be Doing

Commercial Opportunity and Quoting Analysis

Collect, review, interpret, and analyze claims, utilization, pricing, and other datasets associated with prospective client opportunities.
Analyze patient populations, medications, utilization patterns, treatment activity, and other relevant information to help identify potential OptiMed service opportunities.
Partner with clinical, pharmacy, and other subject matter experts to apply appropriate clinical, utilization, pricing, and service assumptions to commercial analyses.
Support external client and partner communications with a customer-focused, sales-oriented approach, responding to reporting inquiries and deliver analytical insights in a clear and actionable manner that supports strong client relationships.
Quantify potential opportunity size, utilization, savings, revenue, and other commercial measures using established methodologies and assumptions.
Develop analytical scenarios that allow Sales and leadership to evaluate alternative service, pricing, or utilization assumptions.
Prepare accurate, organized, and understandable analytical outputs supporting opportunity evaluation, quoting, proposals, and commercial discussions.
Clearly identify assumptions, data limitations, exceptions, and areas requiring additional subject matter review.

Data Analysis and Quality

Review and validate data used in claims analysis to ensure accuracy and completeness.
Identify discrepancies, missing information, or unusual results requiring additional review.
Maintain clear documentation of key assumptions and calculations used in the analysis.
Utilize Excel and available reporting tools to analyze data and prepare consistent outputs.
Appropriately apply established business rules.
Partner with Reporting Analysts, Technology, and other internal resources when additional data, reporting, or technical support is needed.
Maintain and improve existing analytical templates and tools to support efficient and consistent analysis.
Follow applicable HIPAA, privacy, information security, and data handling requirements.

Who You’ll Be Working With

The Infusion Pharmacy Technician works under the direct supervision of licensed pharmacists and collaborates closely with fellow pharmacy technicians and other specialty pharmacy team members. This role regularly communicates with patients, caregivers, prescriber offices, insurance providers, financial-assistance programs, and internal operational teams to coordinate prescription processing and resolve barriers to medication access. Through timely communication and careful follow-through, the Specialty Pharmacy Technician helps create a smooth and supportive experience throughout the patient’s specialty pharmacy journey.

Skills And Experience You’ll Bring To The Table

Education

Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Data Analytics, Healthcare Administration, Information Systems, or a related field; or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.

Experience

Two to five years of related analytical, business, financial, or healthcare experience preferred.
Demonstrated experience using Microsoft Excel to analyze and organize data.
Experience working with healthcare and pharmacy claims, pricing, or financial data is preferred but not required.
Demonstrated ability and willingness to learn new systems, analytical tools, and business processes.

Competencies You’ll Bring To The Table

Strong analytical, critical-thinking, and problem-solving skills.
Clinical awareness on services rendered and how medication regimen variability impacts analysis work.
Strong proficiency with Microsoft Excel and the ability to work effectively with large and complex datasets.
Strong attention to detail with the ability to identify discrepancies, trends, and unusual results.
Ability to understand and consistently apply established business rules, assumptions, and methodologies.
Technical aptitude with the ability to learn and effectively use healthcare, reporting, and analytical applications.
Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple requests, priorities, and deadlines.
Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to explain analytical findings clearly.
Ability to collaborate effectively with Sales, Operations, Finance, Pharmacy, Reporting, Technology, and other subject matter experts.
Ability to maintain confidentiality and appropriately handle sensitive patient, client, and financial information.

Work Environment

This is a hybrid position with flexible hours working remotely and onsite in our Kalamazoo, Michigan office. Minimal travel; as required for conferences, training and other business purposes.
